brainbot develops AI and software systems for environments where trust, control and auditability are essential.

The company was founded in 2000 as a spin-off of the German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), first as a search engine company. Since 2014, brainbot has built privacy infrastructure for critical systems: sensitive business processes, private AI infrastructure, cryptographic protocols and digital elections.
AI consulting for sensitive business processes.
brainbot helps companies bring AI into processes where data has to stay under control, from the first analysis and a fixed-scope pilot through to production.
brainbot is developing a digital voting system for municipalities, universities, unions and cooperatives, where votes stay hidden from absolutely everyone, and anyone can still verify the results.
With Shutter Network, software developed by brainbot, we provide threshold encryption that protects transactions from attacks that manipulate their order.

Heiko Franssen has two decades of enterprise technology leadership. He has led brainbot since 2020, helping companies with sensitive business processes adopt AI, from strategy and architecture through to production. He also hosts KI am Werk, brainbot's video series about AI in real companies.

Lightforce: private AI for an engineering company | indie.solutions
How Lightforce, an aircraft and drone engineering company, runs a private AI Brain on an indie.box, with a virtual wind tunnel and its own roadmap app.
How Lightforce puts its engineering knowledge to work.

Lightforce, an aircraft and drone engineering company, runs a private AI Brain and AI Agent Command Center on an indie.box in its own office. Co-founder Reinhart Paelinck shows how it works in this 12-minute episode of KI am Werk.
Video: KI am Werk, episode 3, with Reinhart Paelinck of Lightforce
Play the episode with Reinhart Paelinck of Lightforce

Lightforce wanted its internal knowledge, engineering data and code within easy reach, with AI agents that could work with it. The condition was clear: no data could leave the company, and nothing could be lost. In Reinhart's words, “It's really important that nothing can be deleted by accident.”
Custom apps on their own knowledge
A virtual wind tunnel, where the team changes aircraft designs. When another project updates, the app can pull that in straight away.
A roadmap app for project planning, built by a Lightforce colleague. It replaced an outside tool at around €50 per seat per year, of which the team only used a small part.
Apps and AI side by side
The agent sits next to every app. What someone changes in the app, the agent can read and keep working with, which suits simulations, dashboards and tables.

The agents run locally on the indie.box, with read-only access to company data and no internet access unless the team allows it. Each one works in a sealed container that lets it read, answer through one set channel and make small changes in its own workspace. Reinhart calls it “the best solution there is right now.”
A colleague from brainbot brought the indie.box to Lightforce and plugged it in. About 20 minutes later the first systems were connected, and the team connected everything else it needed from there.

Is this an alternative to ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot?

Yes, for companies that want to keep their data in-house. Your team asks questions in plain language, like with ChatGPT or Copilot, but the AI runs on-premise on your own device, works with your company knowledge, and is set up to meet GDPR requirements.

On-premise AI runs on hardware in your own building instead of a provider's cloud. With indie.solutions, that is one of four devices, from the compact indie.box to the indie.rack, with the AI Brain, AI Agent Command Center and Agent Studio preinstalled.
Which device should we start with?
Most teams start with the indie.box. If people mostly wait for answers while they work, like when coding, the indie.workstation is the better fit. For 100 users or more, look at the indie.rack.
Is the software the same on every device?
Yes. Every device runs the same software, so your apps and agents keep working when you add or change devices.
Is the software included in the price?
Yes. The software comes preinstalled and is part of the one-time purchase.
Does it work without an internet connection?
Yes. The devices can run fully offline.
Only your own administrators. The devices send no telemetry, and your data never trains AI models.

Yes. You can add your own models next to the preinstalled ones.

You start updates from the admin dashboard. With indie.care, updates, security patches and support are taken care of.

Yes. Add an indie.booster to an indie.box, add workstations, or move to a rack. What you have stays part of the system.

That depends on where it runs. On your own server from indie.box, everything stays in your office. In the sealed cloud (TEE), your data stays encrypted even while it is processed, so not even we or the cloud provider can see it.
Is our data used to train AI models?
No. Nothing your team asks or stores is ever used to train AI models.
Yes. We sign a data processing agreement before setup, and on your own server your data never leaves your building.
Can employees only see what they are allowed to?
Yes. Employees can keep knowledge in the AI Brain private or share it with their team, so each person sees only what they should.
Can the agent change our data?
Only when you allow it. By default the agent can only read. It makes changes only through actions you switch on, you decide for each app whether it may edit it, and every action is logged.
Which AI models does it use?
It runs open AI models, such as Qwen and GPT-OSS. On your own server they run locally, so nothing is sent to an outside AI provider, and new models arrive as software updates.
Does it work with the systems we already use?

Yes. The AI Brain runs alongside the systems you already use, so nothing has to be replaced. The AI Brain connects to your shared drives, email and code with read-only access, and file servers and other systems can be connected on request.
On your own server, yes. The AI runs locally in your office, with no internet connection needed. The sealed cloud needs an internet connection.
None for the sealed cloud. For a local setup, we install a device from indie.solutions in your office.
Do we need our own IT staff to run it?
No. We install it and connect your first systems, and indie.care covers updates and support. Some technical know-how helps for your network setup and company login.

Usually about 14 days until your AI Brain is set up and running. It finishes with a two-day setup workshop with your team. During those two days, we connect your first systems and build your first custom apps.
We build the first apps around the way your team works. After that, your team can ask the agent for new ones, and we keep building with you as your needs grow.
Can we try it before we buy?
Yes. Request a trial, and we will set one up for your team.
What happens when our team grows?
The device is a one-time purchase. If you need more capacity later, an indie.booster adds more power to your indie.box. With the sealed cloud, usage fees grow with how much you use it.
Can it carry our own branding?
Yes. Your apps show your company name and logo, like the Lightforce example in the videos on this page.
What happens to our apps if we stop working with you?
They stay yours. The apps, their settings and your data belong to you, even if you stop working with us.

You pay once for the package, with no fee per user. It includes six months of indie.care. After that, indie.care is optional and billed monthly. With the sealed cloud, the cloud service bills you for what you use. Request a trial and we will put together a quote.
